## CC0 FreeCAD helper fixtures

These synthetic documents come from `cad-fixture-recipes-creo`, generated by its public
FreeCAD recipe script in FreeCAD 0.21.2 (saved ProgramVersion `0.21R33771 (Git)`).
They are dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0.

- `freecad_0_21_2_F16b.FCStd`: recipe F16b, two pads with a SubShapeBinder referencing a
  datum plane; the second sketch is attached to the binder's face.
- `freecad_0_21_2_F18b.FCStd`: recipe F18b, a pad and an unused datum coordinate system.
- `freecad_0_21_2_F18c.FCStd`: recipe F18c, a datum point used to place a coordinate system.
- `freecad_0_21_2_F14b.FCStd`: recipe F14b, a primitive attached through a datum point.

The ShapeBinder regression derives an archive from F16b in memory by changing only its
binder type to `PartDesign::ShapeBinder`. This is a synthetic decoder input, not a document
saved by FreeCAD with that type. No other design files are used.

The hidden-container regression also derives from F16b in memory: it adds a hidden
`App::Part` containing the first Body, while leaving the Body and Pad's own visibility
flags unchanged. This checks ancestor visibility without needing another saved fixture.

## FreeCAD parameter fixtures

These synthetic documents come from CAD Fixture Recipes v1.30, generated with FreeCAD
0.21.2. The recipes and their generated files are dedicated to the public domain under
CC0-1.0. No third-party design files are included.

| File | Recipe | Source volume | Parameter edit and expected volume |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recipe-P12a-freecad-0.21.2.FCStd` | P12a, spreadsheet-driven plate width and pad depth | 6000 mm³ | `plate_w`: 20 → 25 mm; 9375 mm³ (P12b) |
| `recipe-N11a-freecad-0.21.2.FCStd` | N11a, spreadsheet alias driving sketch width | 6000 mm³ | `w`: 30 → 45 mm; 9000 mm³ (N11b) |

The volumes and edits are recorded in the generated set's `manifest.json`. Both files
exercise named sketch constraint expressions as well as spreadsheet parameters.

## FreeCAD helix fixture

`F13a-freecad-1.1.4.FCStd` is recipe F13, variant a, from the CC0-1.0 CAD fixture
recipes, generated with FreeCAD 1.1.4 (build 4fd3bf320d9566a27e60069fc8387448aaa3a094).
It is a four-turn right-handed AdditiveHelix with a 5 mm pitch, a 10 mm centre radius,
and a 2 mm circular section. The profile plane is normal to the initial helix tangent.
The recipe's manifest measures one solid, 792.06459406 mm³. The document includes
spreadsheet parameters. It was copied unchanged from `generated/freecad-1.1.4/F13a.FCStd`.
This synthetic fixture is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0.
